big_case.notes: Wrongful-death FAAAA preemption dispute from a published California Court of Appeal decision (114 Cal. App. 5th 873) involving a major national retail receiver (Walmart) and agricultural shipper (Irigoyen Farms). Although Question 2 raises a recurring statutory threshold question on shipper/receiver coverage under 49 U.S.C. § 14501(c)(1), no circuit split had matured on that issue and the Court resolved the petition via a routine follow-on GVR under Montgomery v. Caribe Transport II, LLC, 608 U.S. 219 (2026), without plenary briefing or new Supreme Court doctrine.
